therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Percentage of participants achieving either complete response (CR) or very good partial response (VGPR)

biomarker_changes: ≥90% reduction in serum IgM level from baseline
Disappearance of monoclonal protein by immunofixation
subgroup_findings: Zanubrutinib showed numerically higher CR/VGPR rates (28.4% vs 19.2%)
Similar major response rates between arms (77.5% vs 77.8%)
Better PFS event-free rates with zanubrutinib at 48 months (78.3% vs 67.3%)
results.dose_information: BGB-3111: 160 mg PO BID; Ibrutinib: 420 mg PO QD

context.duration: Up to approximately 5 years and 5 months
